web route demands it; the template set attaches as usual.

-- web/web.go --
package web

import (
	"net/http"

	fabrikweb "github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/web"
)

// NotFoundPage is the 404 page's view model.
type NotFoundPage struct {
	Path string
}

type ErrorPages struct{}

//fabrik:web:notfound
func (e *ErrorPages) NotFound(req *fabrikweb.Request) (fabrikweb.Response, error) {
	r := req.HTTP()
	return fabrikweb.Template("errors/404", NotFoundPage{Path: r.URL.Path}), nil
}

//fabrik:web:methodnotallowed
func (e *ErrorPages) MethodNotAllowed(req *fabrikweb.Request) (fabrikweb.Response, error) {
	return fabrikweb.Template("errors/405", nil), nil
}

//fabrik:http GET /
func Home(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {}
-- want/main.gen.go --
// Code generated by fabrik. DO NOT EDIT.
// Regenerate with: fabrik wire

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/router"
	web2 "github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/web"

	"app/web"
)

func run() int {
	if err := func() (err error) {
		// Providers
		r := router.New()
		webErrorPages := &web.ErrorPages{}
		requestFuncs := web2.DefaultRequestFuncs()
		webTemplates, err := web2.LoadTemplates(web.Templates, "templates", requestFuncs.Stubs())
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		adapter := web2.NewAdapter(web2.WithRenderer(webTemplates), web2.WithRequestFuncs(requestFuncs))

		// Register
		r.NotFound(adapter.Wrap(webErrorPages.NotFound))
		r.MethodNotAllowed(adapter.Wrap(webErrorPages.MethodNotAllowed))
		r.Method("GET", "/", web.Home)
		return nil
	}(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "app:", err)
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}
